notes.title: We are preparing the English and Janapese translation now
notes.content:
1.26 update:

We are preparing the English and Janapese translation now. Thanks for all the translators participating in this project!

--------------------------------------------------

Original:

Hello everyone, I am the developer of "The Inquisitor". I have just released this game on steam with the help of Eleanoa. Thanks to Theta, Violacea, the Cup, Fux2 and other friends for their efforts on game development and testing. Hope that the game will make you feel satisfied. All feedbacks and suggestions are welcomed.

One of the ideas of releasing on steam is to receive feedback from players with languages other than Chinese, but the translation task is far beyond my ability. If anyone can help translate this game into English or Japanese, here is my thanks!

Since the game has small resolution, translation may involve issues like typesetting. We need to communicate with each other in the translation process. If you need to modify the user interface or make some modifications on game content, I will handle as soon as possible.

Thanks again for your support of the game!
